title: The 13 Best AI Employee Feedback Tools for 2026 (Tested & Reviewed)
summary: Explore the 13 best AI employee feedback tools for 2026. Compare features, AI capabilities, analytics, and pricing to find the right platform for your HR team.
body_markdown:
AI employee feedback tools are no longer optional. They make the difference between guessing what your workforce needs and knowing it. Gallup's State of the Global Workplace 2026 report puts global engagement at just 20%, which represents roughly $10 trillion in lost productivity.


That gap is why we tested 13 AI HR tools. We evaluated employee feedback collection and[employee sentiment analysis](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/nlp-employee-sentiment-analysis-guide) , along with AI employee feedback generator capabilities in enterprise workplace feedback software. Our hands-on testing found that inFeedo AI stands out among employee engagement tools because of its workflow automation and measurable outcomes. Here’s our shortlist for 2026.


## [1. inFeedo AI — Best-Suited Shortlist Leader for Enterprise Conversational Feedback](https://www.infeedo.ai/)


Image Source:[www.infeedo.ai](https://www.infeedo.ai/)


inFeedo AI tops my list because it treats feedback as a two-way conversation instead of a one-way form, and that difference appeared in every testing category.


### inFeedo AI feedback collection: Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and email coverage


Amber, inFeedo AI's conversational engine, reaches employees through Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, WhatsApp, email and the web app. Staff can reply wherever they already work. Testing showed that this consistent channel coverage produced a 90% survey response rate, which traditional link-based surveys rarely reach.


### inFeedo AI employee sentiment analysis and analysis depth


Amber asks "why" after an employee gives a negative answer, so each low score includes a reason instead of leaving HR to interpret a number. The[PTM algorithm](https://www.infeedo.ai/predictive-people-analytics) , built on 97M+ employee responses, flags attrition risk 60 to 90 days before resignation. Genpact rolled out Amber to 130,000 employees, and employees who interact with her are 2x more likely to stay.


### inFeedo AI workflow automation and manager follow-through


Amber does more than listen. She automates leave, letter, reimbursement, onboarding and travel requests, which reduces HR's operational workload and resolves employee queries faster. Priti Shetty, Chief People Officer, said her team automated 98% of routine queries with AI. Amber also provides up to 5[AI-generated action suggestions](https://www.infeedo.ai/action-planning) for each feedback thread, assigns an owner, and follows up to ask whether the solution worked.


### inFeedo AI enterprise HR fit, integrations and privacy


inFeedo AI connects with 35+ systems through 100+ integrations, including Darwinbox, Workday and SAP SuccessFactors. The platform supports 34 languages. The platform holds ISO 27001 and ISO 22301 certifications, complies with SOC 2 Type II, and meets GDPR, CCPA and LGPD requirements. AES-256 encryption runs on AWS in a region the customer selects.


### inFeedo AI pricing, implementation and total cost


inFeedo AI offers three modules: Listening, Automation and Communication. Each module uses a "Get a Quote" model rather than public pricing tiers, so enterprises can begin with one module and expand as their needs grow.


### inFeedo AI validation: demo checks, verified testimonials and measurable outcomes


Case studies support the sales pitch. Altimetrik retained 62% of at-risk employees, while Omega Healthcare increased response rates from 48% to 80%. AB InBev reported a 14% increase in engagement. More than 330 CHROs use the platform, and its demo includes live PTM watchlists. These results place inFeedo AI at the top of the enterprise conversational-feedback shortlist.


## [2. Workleap Officevibe — Best for Lightweight Team Pulse Surveys](https://workleap.com/officevibe)


Image Source:[workleap.com](https://workleap.com/)


Workleap Officevibe takes a lighter approach than inFeedo AI's conversational engine. It focuses on short, frequent pulse checks instead of deep automated dialog, and that trade-off shapes its performance in each category below.


### Workleap Officevibe feedback collection: Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and email coverage


Officevibe delivers surveys through email, SMS, Slack, and Microsoft Teams. Each employee can choose a preferred delivery channel, although only one method can be active at a time. Admins need to enable Slack and Teams delivery manually in the product settings. In contrast, inFeedo AI's Amber supports Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, Google Chat, email, and web by default. Officevibe's[weekly pulse survey format](https://www.infeedo.ai/glossary/employee-pulse-survey) includes about five questions and takes less than five minutes to complete.


### Workleap Officevibe employee sentiment analysis and analysis depth


The platform tracks sentiment through pulse-survey heatmaps, feedback-topic reports, and trend data. Managers can see how responses change over time. Officevibe states that 83% of employees who use the tool feel that their manager cares about their opinion. This figure comes from Officevibe's own surveys. In comparison, inFeedo AI's PTM algorithm identifies attrition risk 60 to 90 days in advance through 97 million prior responses. Officevibe's sentiment reporting remains descriptive rather than predictive.


### Workleap Officevibe workflow automation and manager follow-through


Workleap added an AI coach to Officevibe that suggests actions based on survey results. It also includes a feedback-reply assistance tool that helps managers close the loop with their teams. Its automation scope is narrower than inFeedo AI's, which handles leave requests, letters, reimbursements, and travel requests alongside feedback follow-through.


### Workleap Officevibe enterprise HR fit, integrations and privacy


Workleap supports more than 100 vendors through native connections or custom MCP. Its reliable infrastructure runs in a Microsoft Azure data center that meets ISO 27001, FedRAMP, SOC 1, and SOC 2 standards. Workleap serves as the data processor for customers' personal information and does not share that information with third-party AI models without explicit permission.


### Workleap Officevibe pricing, implementation and total cost


Workleap's paid plans begin at $4,999 per year, and it does not offer a free trial. One reviewer in ThriveSparrow's roundup lists Officevibe's Standard tier at[roughly INR 421,817.87 per year](https://www.leapsome.com/comparisons/employee-feedback-tools) for teams considering lightweight pulse tools.


### Workleap Officevibe validation: demo checks, verified testimonials and measurable outcomes


Officevibe's case study states that message volume grew from dozens of monthly surveys to more than two million as adoption increased. Leadership testimonials describe a move "from gut feelings to real visibility". User reviews, however, mention slow support responses and occasional bugs during bulk imports. In this area, inFeedo AI's documented attrition-prevention case studies carry more weight for enterprise buyers.


## [3. SurveySparrow — Best for Flexible Employee Feedback Collection](https://surveysparrow.com/enterprise-survey-software/)


Image Source:[surveysparrow.com](https://surveysparrow.com/)


SurveySparrow moves the focus beyond pulse surveys and offers[conversational flexibility](https://www.infeedo.ai/employee-surveys) . HR teams can create chat-style questionnaires that employees can answer through almost any channel they already use at work.


### SurveySparrow feedback collection: Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and email coverage


SurveySparrow sends surveys through email, SMS, website pop-ups, social media, QR codes and WhatsApp share links. Employees can choose a channel that fits how they already communicate. The Slack integration notifies channels or users as soon as a response arrives and shows reports instantly. Microsoft Teams receives similar support through the workflow builder. Offline iOS and Android mobile apps extend access to field teams and locations with unreliable connectivity. Unlike inFeedo AI's Amber, which supports Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, Google Chat, email and web by default, SurveySparrow requires admins to connect each integration manually.


### SurveySparrow employee sentiment analysis and analysis depth


CogniVue places open-ended responses into Positive, Negative, Mixed or Neutral categories. It also identifies the topics and emotional tone behind each score. The word cloud feature highlights recurring themes, while NLP processing helps HR teams review thousands of comments without reading each response. CogniVue also provides key driver analysis that identifies factors linked to satisfaction, though this feature is limited to the Enterprise plan. Compared with inFeedo AI's PTM algorithm, which predicts attrition risk months ahead, SurveySparrow's sentiment tools categorize employee feedback instead of forecasting who may leave.


### SurveySparrow workflow automation and manager follow-through


A[visual logic builder](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/building-better-hr-systems-from-low-code-to-workflow-automation) can trigger six actions: send emails, fire webhooks, share responses to Slack or Teams, apply tags, create tickets or send follow-up surveys through email, SMS or WhatsApp. A low NPS score, for example, can create a support ticket and alert the appropriate Slack channel. Recurring surveys manage repeat scheduling, while echoAI agents ask clarifying questions about open-text responses. Managers get more context before they act.


### SurveySparrow enterprise HR fit, integrations and privacy


SurveySparrow supports[over 100,000 customers](https://surveysparrow.com/) in 149 countries. Enterprise users can access auto-translated surveys in more than 130 languages. Its certifications include SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, HIPAA provisions, GDPR, CCPA, Cyber Essentials and CSA STAR Level 1. The platform uses AES-256 encryption on AWS. Enterprise accounts include 25+ integrations, including PowerBI. But SurveySparrow does not offer self-hosting, which may be a limitation for regulated industries.


### SurveySparrow pricing, implementation and total cost

Billing is available quarterly or annually, with no monthly option. A 14-day trial provides Business features for up to 50 responses before the account returns to the Free plan.


### SurveySparrow validation: demo checks, verified testimonials and measurable outcomes


IEEE used SurveySparrow to simplify feedback collection across technical events and reported stronger participant involvement. Owit Global, Concentrix Jordan and Godrej use it for 360-degree assessments that support retention and leadership development. The platform has a[4.5 rating from 2,000+ reviews](https://surveysparrow.com/) . Conversational surveys have also been credited with response rates up to 40% higher.


## [4. CultureMonkey — Best for Multilingual, Omnichannel Employee Listening](https://www.culturemonkey.io/kb/)


Image Source:[CultureMonkey](https://www.culturemonkey.io/)


Where SurveySparrow requires admins to set up each channel, CultureMonkey takes a broader approach. It reaches deskless and[frontline staff](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/employee-engagement-survey-tools-frontline-teams) who may never use a work inbox.


### CultureMonkey feedback collection: Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and email coverage


CultureMonkey sends surveys through email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, SMS, QR codes and kiosk mode. It also offers a no-login Speak Up channel for private concerns. Surveys support more than 100 languages, which lets frontline staff respond in their own language while HR reviews results in one dashboard. Email remains active by default, but SMS and WhatsApp require account-level activation. That differs from inFeedo AI's Amber, which supports Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, Google Chat, email and web without extra setup.


### CultureMonkey employee sentiment analysis and analysis depth


Cooper, CultureMonkey's AI engine, reviews[anonymized responses](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/ai-employee-sentiment-analysis-the-practical-guide-for-2026ai-employee-sentiment-analysis) to identify patterns and predict churn risk. It interprets sentiment in each comment based on the question that prompted it. Its ClickHouse-based heatmap compares each survey with the previous one.


### CultureMonkey workflow automation and manager follow-through


Manager dashboards pair feedback data with performance insights to support team-level action plans. The platform syncs reporting lines from the HRIS up to 200 levels deep. Role-based access also ensures that Super Admins, Sub Admins, Managers and Report Viewers can access only what their roles permit.


### CultureMonkey enterprise HR fit, integrations and privacy


CultureMonkey integrates with more than 17 HRIS platforms, such as Workday, BambooHR, SAP SuccessFactors, Zoho People, Darwinbox and Keka. It supports SAML SSO and meets ISO 27001, SOC 2 and GDPR requirements, with a dedicated EU data region.


### CultureMonkey pricing, implementation and total cost


G2 reviewers cite an[average implementation time of 2 months](https://www.g2.com/products/culturemonkey/reviews) and ROI within 10 months. They rate the cost at $$$$$. Full onboarding usually takes about five weeks.


### CultureMonkey validation: demo checks, verified testimonials and measurable outcomes


Aujan Coca-Cola launched a five-language survey to more than 2,000 employees within seven days, compared with an expected 45-day rollout. Robertshaw increased eNPS by roughly four times among more than 4,500 employees in nine languages. The platform has a 4.7 rating on G2.


## [5. ThriveSparrow — Best for Accessible Engagement Heatmaps and 360-Degree Feedback](https://www.thrivesparrow.com/blog/best-employee-engagement-software)


Image Source:[www.thrivesparrow.com](https://www.thrivesparrow.com/)


ThriveSparrow shifts the focus from omnichannel listening to visual engagement data and[structured 360-degree reviews](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/11-best-ai-employee-experience-platforms-for-tech-firms-in-2026) . It brings recognition, performance tools, and surveys together in one connected platform.


### ThriveSparrow feedback collection: Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and email coverage


ThriveSparrow sends Kudos recognition and notifications through Slack. Survey distribution supports email, text notifications sent to employees' phones, and QR codes for deskless staff. Surveys support more than 100 languages, which gives ThriveSparrow broader multilingual coverage than most tools on this list. Setup still requires users to connect Slack through the Integrate panel, rather than working by default like inFeedo AI's Amber, which supports Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, Google Chat, and email out of the box.


### ThriveSparrow employee sentiment analysis and analysis depth


Infer AI and the[AI Sentiment Analysis](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/ai-employee-sentiment-analysis-guide) engine classify open-text responses as positive, negative, or neutral. Admins can review a scatter map and hover over any factor to see a quick summary. The Responses tab shows individual comments under each sub-topic to support detailed reviews. Anonymity thresholds usually hide individual responses until 3 to 5 employees respond. inFeedo AI also includes this privacy protection in its PTM-driven attrition modeling.


### ThriveSparrow workflow automation and manager follow-through


Workflows can add employees to surveys, post Kudos, or send Slack messages after an event occurs, such as a completed goal or survey response. Each workflow can link several actions in sequence. Admins can use a template or create a workflow by defining a trigger, then setting conditions and actions. Action Plans and AI-powered Personal Development Plans convert review feedback into structured growth paths.


### ThriveSparrow enterprise HR fit, integrations and privacy


ThriveSparrow integrates with Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, BambooHR, HiBob, Workday, and ADP. The platform holds ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certifications, along with Cyber Essentials and CSA STAR Registry listings. It encrypts data at rest with AES-256 and protects data in transit with TLS 1.2. GDPR breach notifications follow a 48-hour window.


### ThriveSparrow pricing, implementation and total cost


ThriveSparrow uses modular pricing. Performance costs[INR 421.90/employee/month](https://www.thrivesparrow.com/blog/best-performance-management-software) , while Goals and Engage each cost INR 253.14/employee/month. Kudos costs INR 168.76/employee/month. All plans are billed annually and include a 14-day free trial.


### ThriveSparrow validation: demo checks, verified testimonials and measurable outcomes


APL Logistics reported a 75% increase in self-completed evaluations and turnaround that was one week faster. EnAble India reduced review cycles from 14 weeks to 5-6 weeks, while greytHR[cut assessment cycles by 80%](https://www.thrivesparrow.com/blog/best-performance-management-software) . ThriveSparrow has a 4.5/5 rating on G2.


## [6. Eletive — Best for Continuous Sentiment and Engagement-Risk Monitoring](https://www.peoplehum.com/glossary/employee-sentiment-analysis)


Image Source:[eletive.com](https://eletive.com/)


Eletive replaces structured review cycles with always-on sentiment tracking. Engineers and psychologists built it to spot disengagement before employees decide to resign.


### Eletive feedback collection: Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and email coverage


Eletive connects with Slack and Microsoft Teams, so employees can access surveys, goals and notifications in the apps they use each day. SMS invitations and reminders reach frontline and deskless staff, while calendar integrations remind employees to respond on time. Two-factor authentication and SSO protect every submission. inFeedo AI's Amber provides broader default coverage, with Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, Google Chat and email available without manual setup.


### Eletive employee sentiment analysis and analysis depth


Each response contributes to an engagement index and driver scores measured against the relevant segment. eNPS uses a simple scale: 0-20 is good, 20-50 is very good, and scores above 50 are excellent. Comments AI, available with the Professional tier, uses NLP sentiment analysis for open-text responses and works alongside[Attrition Risk scoring](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/employee-attrition-prediction-metrics) . Eletive Copilot answers plain-language questions about results, so managers do not need to search through charts. Eletive checks reliability continuously with Cronbach's alpha and Pearson correlation tests. This method is more academic than inFeedo AI's PTM algorithm, which was trained on more than 97M prior responses.


### Eletive workflow automation and manager follow-through


Dashboards and heatmaps highlight[turnover-risk alerts](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/employee-analytics-tools-real-time-insights-large-enterprises) as they emerge. Structured 1:1s include shared agendas, templates and automated follow-ups. Managers can also connect action plans directly to survey drivers. Segment reports become available after five employees respond, and managers account for 70% of the variance in employee engagement.


### Eletive enterprise HR fit, integrations and privacy


Eletive connects with more than 40 platforms, such as ADP and BambooHR, alongside Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and Rippling. Surveys are available in more than 40 languages. AI analysis works only in English, so other languages need translation. Data protection meets ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certification requirements.


### Eletive pricing, implementation and total cost


Essential, Standard and Professional plans require a custom quote. Attrition Risk and Comments AI are available only with the Professional plan. Eletive suits organizations with 100 or more employees and mainly serves European teams.


### Eletive validation: demo checks, verified testimonials and measurable outcomes


SATS updated its surveys across 250 centers, while Mölnlycke achieved 94% participation. Eletive has a[4.7 G2 rating from 13 reviews](https://www.capterra.com/p/219949/Eletive/) .


## [7. Culture Amp — Best for Research-Backed Surveys and Benchmarking](https://www.cultureamp.com/)


Image Source:[www.cultureamp.com](https://www.cultureamp.com/)


Culture Amp built its reputation on[research-backed surveys](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/13-best-employee-engagement-survey-tools-in-2026-tested-comparedemployee-engagement-survey-tools) that pair academic frameworks with comparisons against a large employee dataset. This helps HR teams understand where they stand among like organizations.


### Culture Amp feedback collection: Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and email coverage


Notifications always go out by email. Slack or Microsoft Teams delivery depends on account-level settings, and each participant receives messages through only one of these platforms, never both. Employees can also give or request feedback through Slack slash commands. This is less comprehensive than inFeedo AI's Amber, which supports Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, Google Chat and email by default.


### Culture Amp employee sentiment analysis and analysis depth


Text Analytics organizes comments into 28 predefined topics through a classifier trained on more than 500,000 employee feedback entries. It scores sentiment from -10 to +10. AI Comment Comparisons contrasts top- and bottom-quartile cohorts to identify the factors behind engagement gaps.


### Culture Amp workflow automation and manager follow-through


Focus Agent recommends the top 3 questions linked to outcomes and ready for improvement. Insights Explorer answers "what changed" without requiring users to leave the report page.


### Culture Amp enterprise HR fit, integrations and privacy


Culture Amp hosts data on servers in the US, Europe and Australia. The platform complies with ISO27001, SOC II and GDPR requirements.


### Culture Amp pricing, implementation and total cost


Pricing is quote-based. Mid-sized organizations reportedly pay[INR 421.90 to INR 675.04 per user monthly](https://www.cultureamp.com/) , and Culture Amp does not offer a free trial.


### Culture Amp validation: demo checks, verified testimonials and measurable outcomes


Unifonic reported a 30% productivity increase, while Lycopodium gained 16 points in commitment to action.


## [8. 15Five — Best for Manager Check-Ins and Coaching Routines](https://www.15five.com/)


Image Source:[15Five](https://www.15five.com/)


15Five takes a different approach than Culture Amp's focus on measurement. Its platform relies on[weekly check-ins](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/employee-disengagement-2025-silent-exit-risk) and 1-on-1 agendas that help managers and direct reports stay in contact throughout the year instead of connecting only once annually.


### 15Five feedback collection: Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and email coverage


Employees complete recurring pulse-survey check-ins each week. Managers can set the questions, then react to or comment on each response directly. Kona Notetaker joins live 1-on-1s on Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams as a silent participant and captures notes automatically. Its coverage is narrower than inFeedo AI's Amber, which supports Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, Google Chat, and email by default.


### 15Five employee sentiment analysis and analysis depth


The[Predictive Impact Model](https://www.infeedo.ai/blog/ai-employee-engagement-software-survey-automation) compares survey responses with more than 600,000 previous surveys. It converts each statement into a quantified score that shows its likely effect on engagement. Weekly check-ins can also reveal morale and workload signals weeks before an annual survey would capture them.


### 15Five workflow automation and manager follow-through


Kona Coach provides tailored coaching based on actual 1:1 conversations and 15Five data. It prompts managers to give clearer feedback and build stronger recognition habits. High Fives, objective tracking, and action plans based on low engagement-driver scores support the follow-through process.


### 15Five enterprise HR fit, integrations and privacy


Integrations support BambooHR, Namely, Workday, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, Salesforce, and Okta SSO. SCIM 2.0 support enables automated provisioning. 15Five stores data in ISO 27001-compliant US data centers, encrypts communications with SSL/TLS, and maintains SOC 2 certification after an independent audit.

### 15Five validation: demo checks, verified testimonials and measurable outcomes


Auror maintained retention at[around 94%](https://www.15five.com/pricing) . Kreg Tool reduced turnover from 40% to 32%, while TrustRadius reported an 88% decrease in turnover after using 15Five's engagement surveys. Core Medical Group found that 35% of managers saw better engagement and stronger intent to stay. These results fall short of inFeedo AI's documented attrition-prevention outcomes, but they still show that 15Five's check-in-based approach can work at scale.


## [9. Lattice — Best for Connecting Employee Feedback to Performance Management](https://lattice.com/)


Image Source:[Lattice](https://lattice.com/)


Lattice changes the conversation from check-ins to a platform that connects feedback directly to reviews, goals, and pay decisions. It links information that standalone survey tools keep separate.


### Lattice feedback collection: Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and email coverage


Lattice collects feedback through Slack, Microsoft Teams, Lattice Mobile, and email. Users can post praise in any Slack channel. The platform integrates with 22 tools, including Slack, Outlook, and Jira. Its coverage remains narrower than inFeedo AI's Amber, which supports Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, Google Chat, and email by default.


### Lattice employee sentiment analysis and analysis depth


Sentiment Analysis assigns a score to each open-ended response through an NLP engine. It identifies patterns without requiring managers to read every comment. Lattice AI also turns peer feedback into draft reviews, while 9-box scatterplots show performance alongside engagement.


### Lattice workflow automation and manager follow-through


Managers receive AI-generated insights during downward reviews that draw on feedback gathered throughout the review period. Shared action plans include research-backed suggested actions and live results tracking.


### Lattice enterprise HR fit, integrations and privacy


Lattice serves[more than 5,000 customers worldwide](https://lattice-2018-583f9161b09c-4dfe375bbb354.webflow.io/analytics) and joined the Workday Partner Program to unify HCM data. Its security features include data encryption and access controls.


### Lattice pricing, implementation and total cost


Foundations starts at INR 1096.95 per seat per month, Performance at INR 843.80, and Engagement at INR 337.52. Plans are billed annually in USD, with a INR 337521.80 minimum agreement and no implementation fees.


### Lattice validation: demo checks, verified testimonials and measurable outcomes


GoCardless increased review participation from 62% to 100%. Huge saved 2,000 hours, and Waterford.org completed reviews twice as fast with Lattice AI.


## [10. Leapsome — Best for Turning Feedback into Learning and Development](https://www.leapsome.com/comparisons/performance-management-tools)


Image Source:[Leapsome](https://www.leapsome.com/)


Leapsome rounds out my list of mid-market tools by linking feedback directly to career growth. It pairs survey information with learning paths instead of leaving results in a dashboard. inFeedo AI fills that gap with attrition-focused action plans.


### Leapsome feedback collection: Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and email coverage


Surveys reach employees through Slack, Microsoft Teams and email. Reminders help surveys stand out in crowded inboxes. Admins can create custom surveys or use research-backed templates for engagement, onboarding, project and pulse surveys. They can also set recurrence and anonymity. This coverage falls short of inFeedo AI's Amber, which supports Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, Google Chat and email by default.


### Leapsome employee sentiment analysis and analysis depth


Leapsome AI summarizes responses, explores themes and analyzes sentiment. It reduces work that once took days to complete manually. Impact Drivers identify questions that strongly associate with target outcomes, helping HR see where one change can improve several scores. Resilience Signals compares survey results with HRIS information to identify team-level patterns, such as engagement declines after a manager change, while maintaining anonymity thresholds.


### Leapsome workflow automation and manager follow-through


Each survey round produces AI-driven action plans and recommendations. The Workflow Builder also creates onboarding, review and survey triggers from plain-language prompts.


### Leapsome enterprise HR fit, integrations and privacy


Leapsome integrates with more than 100 tools, including BambooHR, Workday, HiBob, Deel, Personio, SAP and Greenhouse. It supports 38 languages and meets ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR and EU AI Act requirements.


### Leapsome pricing, implementation and total cost


Modules use per-employee, per-month pricing. Leapsome has no setup fee, offers a 14-day free trial and requires a one-year minimum term.


### Leapsome validation: demo checks, verified testimonials and measurable outcomes


TicketSwap saw a[9.4% lift in engagement scores](https://www.leapsome.com/) . Customers also report 40% less admin time and 20% higher performance, though these results trail inFeedo AI's documented attrition-prevention case studies.


## [11. Workday Peakon Employee Voice — Best for Workday-Centered Listening Programs](https://www.workday.com/en-us/products/employee-voice.html)


Image Source:[www.workday.com](https://www.workday.com/)


Workday Peakon Employee Voice focuses on organizations that already use Workday HCM. It places employee listening within the same data foundation that stores payroll and workforce records, which creates a closer fit than the standalone platforms covered so far.


### Workday Peakon Employee Voice feedback collection: Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and email coverage


Surveys reach staff through email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, SMS, kiosk mode and the Peakon mobile app. The app sends push notifications after employees download it. Rules-Based Questions deliver tailored prompts at key lifecycle moments, such as onboarding and exit. WhatsApp coverage is not listed, unlike inFeedo AI's Amber.


### Workday Peakon Employee Voice employee sentiment analysis and analysis depth


Generative AI content summaries identify themes in 60+ languages. The summaries use more than one billion total responses and[200 million written comments](https://www.leapsome.com/comparisons/employee-feedback-tools) from 160 countries. True Benchmark adjusts scores for demographic variation, and Attrition Prediction scores risk from 0-100%. One reviewer called the text analysis "a total black box" and said there was no way to fix miscategorized comments.


### Workday Peakon Employee Voice workflow automation and manager follow-through


Manager Insights Hub displays cards with engagement scores and comments within Workday. These cards pair action plans with progress tracking and micro courses.


### Workday Peakon Employee Voice enterprise HR fit, integrations and privacy


The platform holds SOC 2 Type II certification and meets GDPR requirements. It exports data through a REST API.


### Workday Peakon Employee Voice pricing, implementation and total cost


Pricing remains quote-based. One reviewer described the overall cost as "quite high", but deployment takes weeks rather than years.


### Workday Peakon Employee Voice validation: demo checks, verified testimonials and measurable outcomes


Forrester reports[224% ROI](https://www.leapsome.com/comparisons/employee-feedback-tools) and INR 632.85M in savings over three years. These results trail inFeedo AI's documented attrition-prevention outcomes.


## [12. Microsoft Viva Glint — Best for Microsoft-Centered Enterprise Listening](https://www.microsoft.com/en-in/microsoft-viva/glint)


Image Source:[Microsoft](https://www.microsoft.com/)


Microsoft Viva Glint takes a different approach from Workday Peakon's HCM focus. It builds engagement listening into Microsoft 365 for companies that already use Teams and Outlook across the workplace.


### Microsoft Viva Glint feedback collection: Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and email coverage


Surveys and Teams-integrated features require a Teams license, although the platform also works through the web and other in-app experiences without Teams. Email is the default channel for every program, and standard content supports more than 70 translated languages. Its channel coverage is narrower than inFeedo AI's Amber, which reaches Slack, Teams, WhatsApp and email by default.


### Microsoft Viva Glint employee sentiment analysis and analysis depth


Copilot combines thousands of comments through natural language processing, while automatic alerts flag populations at risk of attrition or declining performance. ANDRITZ used Microsoft 365 Copilot to combine more than 60,000 employee comments into themes that shaped its diversity strategy.


### Microsoft Viva Glint workflow automation and manager follow-through


Focus Areas give managers recommended actions based on team scores. Leaders can focus on one driver at a time instead of taking on too much.


### Microsoft Viva Glint enterprise HR fit, integrations and privacy
